name: Desk Helper
description: A computer-use demo: looks at your screen, clicks and types for you, runs host tools you registered and uses MCP servers. Every capability is off until you grant it.

host.purpose: Takes a screenshot of what you choose to share, and lists your open windows, when you press 'Look at my screen'
Moves the pointer, clicks and types text only when you press the demo buttons
Runs the host tools you registered (for example screencapture) when you pick one and press Run
Calls the tools of the MCP servers you registered when you pick one and press Call
